command:
bash -lc set +e; output=$(runtime/bin/redcap status --json --require-scan-complete --fail-on-open 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf '%s
' "$output"; echo 'expected fail-on-open to fail while open tasks remain' >&2; exit 1; fi; printf '%s
' "$output" | rg -F '仍有非终局父任务开放' >/dev/null || { printf '%s
' "$output"; echo 'expected open-task failure' >&2; exit 1; }; echo REDCAP_STATUS_FAIL_ON_OPEN_STILL_STRICT_OK
